evidence_items.finding: no location has produced a sustained positive operating surplus since opening
evidence_items.rationale: No location covering its own cost base is a critical unit economics failure signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: owner cannot draw a personal wage despite combined network revenue growing to AUD 1.4M
evidence_items.rationale: Owner unable to draw income despite scale is a critical adverse financial health signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: committed rental and instructor staffing costs increase with each additional location opened
evidence_items.rationale: Growing committed cost base with each new site is a unit economics adverse signal. financial_health dimension. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: two of the four locations have never generated enough revenue to cover their own operating costs
evidence_items.rationale: Two sites consistently below their own cost base is a critical negative contribution margin signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. Avoids must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: four locations; combined annual revenue AUD 1.4M; 18 total staff; no location-level profit and loss available
evidence_items.rationale: Four-location network with combined revenue and no site-level reporting is a unit economics gap. is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): total class bookings across the network have grown each quarter
evidence_items.rationale: Growing booking volume is a misleading signal when costs are growing faster. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): a new corporate wellness contract was recently secured
evidence_items.rationale: New contract acquisition is a misleading positive signal when underlying unit economics are negative. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): social media following has grown substantially over two years
evidence_items.rationale: Social media growth is a misleading vanity metric when the business cannot cover its cost base. Non-critical, LOW confidence.
